entries.text: There were flappers and fruits in white suits.
entries.raw_text: 1,There were flappers and fruits in white suits.

entries.text: There were wheelchairs, guns, and tickertape.
entries.raw_text: 1,There were wheelchairs, guns, and tickertape.

entries.text: Some blissful little hippy.
entries.raw_text: 1,Some blissful little hippy.

entries.text: We woke up on bloody carpets.
entries.raw_text: 1,We woke up on bloody carpets.

entries.text: He got bored when he didn't have a band, so he started a band.
entries.raw_text: 1,He got bored when he didn't have a band, so he started a band.

entries.text: People call me one hour photo, I've got some hazardous chemicals.
entries.raw_text: 1,People call me one hour photo, I've got some hazardous chemicals.

entries.text: Psycho eyes and a stovepipe hat.
entries.raw_text: 1,Psycho eyes and a stovepipe hat.

entries.text: He did a couple favors for some guys that looked like tuscan raiders.
entries.raw_text: 1,He did a couple favors for some guys that looked like tuscan raiders.

entries.text: Mary's got a bloody nose from sniffing margarita mix.
entries.raw_text: 1,Mary's got a bloody nose from sniffing margarita mix.

entries.text: Went down with like fourteen bucks and woke up with like sixteen grand.
entries.raw_text: 1,Went down with like fourteen bucks and woke up with like sixteen grand.

entries.text: She don't feel all that sweet about the places that she sometimes has to go to get some sleep.
entries.raw_text: 1,She don't feel all that sweet about the places that she sometimes has to go to get some sleep.

entries.text: I drank until I dreamed - when I dreamed I always dreamed about the scene.
entries.raw_text: 1,I drank until I dreamed - when I dreamed I always dreamed about the scene.

entries.text: A thousand kids will fall in love in all the clubs tonight, a thousand other kids will end up gushing blood tonight; Two thousand kids won't get too much sleep tonight - two thousand kids they still feel pretty sweet tonight.
entries.raw_text: 1,A thousand kids will fall in love in all the clubs tonight, a thousand other kids will end up gushing blood tonight; Two thousand kids won't get too much sleep tonight - two thousand kids they still feel pretty sweet tonight.

entries.text: She goes low on the seats when she gets high in her car.
entries.raw_text: 1,She goes low on the seats when she gets high in her car.

entries.text: Stern and stoned and confident, coming up towards the jukebox.
entries.raw_text: 1,Stern and stoned and confident, coming up towards the jukebox.

entries.text: Taking off their clothes, screwing in the surf and going out to shows.
entries.raw_text: 1,Taking off their clothes, screwing in the surf and going out to shows.

entries.text: It's hard to keep trying when half your friends are dying.
entries.raw_text: 1,It's hard to keep trying when half your friends are dying.

entries.text: Taxmen coming around the back with the kevlar vests; Militia men cooking up a batch of crystal meth.
entries.raw_text: 1,Taxmen coming around the back with the kevlar vests; Militia men cooking up a batch of crystal meth.

entries.text: He said "The last guy didn't have to die, but the first four looked so nice I wanted five.".
entries.raw_text: 1,He said "The last guy didn't have to die, but the first four looked so nice I wanted five.".

entries.text: He was gushing blood from wide open wounds and she decided that she loved him.
entries.raw_text: 1,He was gushing blood from wide open wounds and she decided that she loved him.

entries.text: Skimpy little outfits and bad guys acting crazy.
entries.raw_text: 1,Skimpy little outfits and bad guys acting crazy.

entries.text: Kids on the corner are cracking and caving in - turning over and turning other kids in.
entries.raw_text: 1,Kids on the corner are cracking and caving in - turning over and turning other kids in.

entries.text: He was angry and angsty, she was a damned good dancer.
entries.raw_text: 1,He was angry and angsty, she was a damned good dancer.

entries.text: They're tipping over in taprooms, they're shooting through the ceiling and bleeding on the floor.
entries.raw_text: 1,They're tipping over in taprooms, they're shooting through the ceiling and bleeding on the floor.

entries.text: She said "I used to be a speed shooter.".
entries.raw_text: 1,She said "I used to be a speed shooter.".

entries.text: We were young and in love; we just needed our space.
entries.raw_text: 1,We were young and in love; we just needed our space.

entries.text: If she says we partied then I'm pretty sure we partied - I really don't remember. I remember we departed from our bodies.
entries.raw_text: 1,If she says we partied then I'm pretty sure we partied - I really don't remember. I remember we departed from our bodies.

entries.text: The jester kept on jacking off.
entries.raw_text: 1,The jester kept on jacking off.

entries.text: Went down on the Denver slums and woke up in the rocky mountain dawn.
entries.raw_text: 1,Went down on the Denver slums and woke up in the rocky mountain dawn.

entries.text: Is Charlemagne your main man or is he just your sad protector?
entries.raw_text: 1,Is Charlemagne your main man or is he just your sad protector?

entries.text: He drank himself to death.
entries.raw_text: 1,He drank himself to death.

entries.text: The things that make you high will make you die.
entries.raw_text: 1,The things that make you high will make you die.

entries.text: Some borderline whore asked me how I'm liking California.
entries.raw_text: 1,Some borderline whore asked me how I'm liking California.

entries.text: When the crowd went wild, we were under the stands.
entries.raw_text: 1,When the crowd went wild, we were under the stands.

entries.text: He was on a rocky mountain freedom binge.
entries.raw_text: 1,He was on a rocky mountain freedom binge.

entries.text: The cheerleaders got gruesome.
entries.raw_text: 1,The cheerleaders got gruesome.

entries.text: "I should have kicked it with your cousin when I had the opportunity.".
entries.raw_text: 1,"I should have kicked it with your cousin when I had the opportunity.".

entries.text: Say a prayer for the Cityscape Skins - half are getting sprung and half are getting back in.
entries.raw_text: 1,Say a prayer for the Cityscape Skins - half are getting sprung and half are getting back in.

entries.text: The Gangster Disciples knocked me off of my bicycle - it was midnight down by Selby & Griggs.
entries.raw_text: 1,The Gangster Disciples knocked me off of my bicycle - it was midnight down by Selby & Griggs.
